Stockfish.js 19 (lite, single-threaded) — WebAssembly build of the Stockfish chess engine.

  files:    stockfish-19-lite-single.js, stockfish-19-lite-single.wasm (unmodified, from npm "stockfish@19.0.0")
  origin:   https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js   (build scripts and source)
  engine:   https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish
  network:  nn-61e7af4bb97d by Chris Bao (sscg13), embedded in the .wasm
